text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, January 31, 2023, Appeal DDRT2023-17.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Amended the application for appeal under File for Mary Ferguson - Appeal DDRT2023-17, to be from Mary Ferguson as applicant, and that Robert Ferguson be named as representative, and pursuant to Section 23 of the Statutory Powers and Procedures Act, and on consent of the parties. 2. Rescinded the determination of a dangerous dog and exempted the Applicant from compliance with the Dangerous Dog Order issued January 31, 2023, and directed that the Tribunal forward the reasons for this decision to Mary Ferguson and/or her Representative and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before September 29, 2023.
